decision: Choose which fact-equivalent tool-result encodings, if any, merit a newly preregistered provider-request replay.
claim_boundary: Mechanical conformance and size measurements can reject invalid or impractical codecs; they cannot establish that a model understands one encoding better.
experimental_unit: One arbitrary JSON value encoded and decoded by one candidate codec.
hard_gates: decoder(encoder(value)) equals the original JSON value under canonical JSON equality for every fixed adversarial value
candidate adds no semantic field or inferred fact
candidate can occupy the existing provider tool-message content string without changing any other request field
selection_rule: Reject any hard-gate failure. Retain production JSON as a candidate. Advance no more than three non-production codecs, selected by complementary structure and size behavior rather than by a favorable single fixture.
prohibited_inference: Do not interpret byte or character savings, model interviews, or codec elegance as model-quality evidence.
provider_execution_gate: No provider replay until candidate implementations, adversarial bank, selection, fixtures, metrics, stopping rule, and revised manifest are frozen in a prior commit.
